title: Beal Level 26 Foundations v24.2.3: Conditional Lower Bound Implies Ratio Bound
description: Branch v24-matveev-conditional-lower from v24.2.2 ffd8343 / 10.5281/zenodo.22731508. Extends BealMatveevThm14.lean and RibetMazur.lean by establishing that if the Matveev lower bound target |Lambda| > exp(C_exp_bound) were true on a gap-3 solution A^4 + B^4 = (B+3)^13, then B^4 / A^4 > exp(C_exp_bound): matveev_conditional_lower_implies_ratio_gt_exp, unconditioned form matveev_conditional_lower_implies_ratio_gt_exp_of_solution, and matveev_gap3_ratio_lower_bound_conditional (solution ∧ matveev_inequality_real_target → B^4 / A^4 > exp(C_exp_bound)). Keeps all v24.0.0 through v24.2.2 lemmas. Links the conditional lower bound toward the Baker B0 = 10^6 reduction without claiming the lower bound itself. Target and baker_bound_gap3 stay uninhabited def Prop (Mathlib 4.12 has no Matveev 2000 Thm 1.4).
